climate.summary: Inland Sarawak generally has rainfall distributed through the year, with a somewhat drier June–August period. Hill slopes in interior Sarawak can be exceptionally wet; METMalaysia cites Long Akah at more than 5,000 mm mean annual rainfall.
climate.best_period_general: Гибкий план; экскурсии зависят от погоды/парка.

geography.summary: Внутренний горно-карстовый Sarawak. Mulu is dominated by Gunung Mulu, Gunung Api and Gunung Benarat and extensive cave systems under primary rainforest.

geology.summary: Limestone mountain ranges are honeycombed by extensive cave and underground-river systems; Sarawak Chamber, Deer Cave and Clearwater Cave System are among the defining features.

nature.forest: Sarawak Forestry lists 15 forest types, 170 wild orchid species and 10 pitcher-plant species in Mulu, plus large bat emergences from Deer Cave.

health.note: Remote-jungle medical/logistical risk is not represented by this state dengue rate.

crime.note: Do not present Kuching/Miri police-district statistics as Mulu risk.

safety.wilderness: Rain, caves, river levels, guide requirements and communications dominate operational risk.

transport.park_access: Sarawak Forestry describes trekking and overnight jungle camps; specific guide requirements vary by route and must be read from current park rules.
